items.label: diagnosis
items.evidence: the default argument is of type `Default` which is a dummy type and thus causes issues when checking it
items.rationale: Identifies the cause in open_zarr's chunks annotation and suggests type from docstring; reference retypes chunks as T_Chunks | Default | None. Not full fix for all args.

there is a `xarray.core.types.T_Chunks` that should cover it.
